title: Add destination_v30: the destination_v25 speed curriculum with the linear run-end ghost pay
summary: destination_v30 is destination_v25's speed curriculum (walks only, a fifth stopping, judged by drift and the evaluator's checks, to 0.15 m/s) with destination_v29's run-end pay, share * max(1 - d / 25 mm, -1) over each 20 s run, and termination 52 for ten times the 5.15 tracking ceiling. Fine-tuned from v9, destination_v29 tracked the ghost to 1-2 mm at 0.05 to 0.1 m/s and closed its starting lag, where the destination_v25 curriculum lineage held a steady lag of up to 30 mm at 0.15 m/s.
next: Run the curriculum on the surrogate from the destination_v29 v9-start update-300 checkpoint and test it against v9.
reason: A named experiment that no gate or registry entry uses yet; the canonical task, reward and evaluator are unchanged.
